text: The Patriots are dealing with significant roster shuffling heading into their Week 3 matchup against Jacksonville, as they've ruled out OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and placed rookie LB Quintayvious Hutchins on injured reserve due to a knee injury, though the good news comes with CB Carlton Davis III's expected return to the lineup and rookie TE Eli Raridon resuming practice as the team evaluates his status for Sunday. Off the field, Christian Gonzalez and Andy Borregales joined the Patriots Foundation in celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month at an event in Boston, while the organization also spotlighted cheerleader Rachel and her background as a dancer and choreographer. On the football side, the Jaguars are preparing to capitalize on what they view as a Patriots team still searching for consistency, though New England has identified a critical area for improvement: the coaching staff has acknowledged the need to better manage the clock before halftime after two consecutive games featuring questionable decisions late in the second quarter.
